Opens an existing file for reading and writing at once, keeping what is in it. Use [SeekFile](SeekFile) to move around before you read or write.

```blitzbasic
;run
file = WriteFile("files_open_example.tmp")
WriteByte file, 1
WriteByte file, 2
CloseFile file
file = OpenFile("files_open_example.tmp")
SeekFile file, 1
WriteByte file, 9
SeekFile file, 0
Print ReadByte(file)
Print ReadByte(file)
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "files_open_example.tmp"
```

```text
1
9
```
@param filename  The file to open.
@returns A file handle, or 0 when the file does not exist.
